permissions.description: Customer engagements that consultants are allocated to

actions.description: Create an engagement owned by the caller
Edit and change the status of the caller's own engagements

permissions.description: Consultants and their hourly cost rates

actions.description: Every consultant, their employee information and rate history
Add consultants from People App, deactivate them, set cost rates
Allocations of the caller's own engagements
Create, check, change and end any allocation
Cost of the caller's own engagements, with each consultant's share
Cost of every engagement and every consultant

Record a travel expense on the caller's own engagement

groups.name: EngagementManagers
groups.description: People who create and run customer engagements

groups.name: ResourceManagers
groups.description: People who maintain consultants and allocate them to engagements

roles.name: EngagementManager
roles.description: Creates and runs their own engagements, sees allocations, cost and travel expenses of those engagements and submits travel expenses to NetSuite. Never sees another manager's engagements or any cost rate list.

roles.name: ResourceManager
roles.description: Maintains consultants and their cost rates, allocates consultants to any engagement and sees every cost. Does not create or edit engagements and does not see travel expenses.

roles.name: FinanceAnalyst
roles.description: Finance staff who read every engagement, consultant, allocation, cost and travel expense. Changes nothing.
